name: Maya
bio: 29, nurse, plays Animal Crossing, Stardew Valley and Unpacking on her Switch and laptop to unwind after shifts. Never played a strategy or crypto game. Chose this because the screenshots looked adorable.
goals: Make a cute restaurant that feels like mine
Understand what to do next without reading a manual
readingStyle: Reads short friendly text; skims anything longer than two sentences; gets anxious when numbers look like finance.
skills: Mouse and trackpad. Clicks anything that looks cute. Never right-click-drags.
researchQuestions: Is the first five minutes clear: what is my goal and what do I click first?
Do the restaurant words (hustle, takings, gold, recipes) make sense without the glossary?
How does a cozy player feel when a rival crew suddenly walks in (incoming service challenge)?
What is the most delightful moment?
quirks: Clicks every critter to see their name
Will close the game if she feels stupid twice in a row
